about: The record of R17 (PLAN_R17.md): study 4's d = 17 row re-registered at q = 8 % on a new test set T6. r17.py reads every pin from this file. engine holds E3's verdict (NO-GO) and its records; the rehearsal ran with this file as it is, and nothing in it changes after the freeze commit.

method.routing: |double(float32 c)| < tau -> correlated PM's decision on that shot; otherwise c > 0
method.how_read: the frozen executable (speed2.s19.t4ours: FROZEN with 4 stages, the router library, the registered tau) records c, its routing and its decision for every T6 shot; the q = 8 % decisions follow from the same c and the same correlated-PM decisions, so one read gives both thresholds
method.nv_code: NVIDIA Ising-Decoding 3ce4379fa6cf475789007bde4b6a8206e8622992 (ICMP_NV; its files are pinned by the freeze's route.nv_sha256)
method.versions_bposd_note: cudaq_qec as its __version__ reads (the freeze's route.bposd.versions, Derecho's; Alpine's venv_cudaq has cudaq-qec-cu12 0.8.0 built from the same cudaqx commit); r17.py bposd checks all five against the loaded packages, and each decoder worker checks the freeze's pins

engine.go: the persistent engine eng17 of branch ising-engine17 at the commit E3 ran; bit-exact with FROZEN on the 200,000 V17b shots (E3's mandatory exactness runs), so its decisions are FROZEN's

e3_records.verdict: VERDICT NO-GO (timing REVISE): grid: block phase 5.87 us (GO <= 5.25, REVISE <= 7.0); whole shot 74.57 us vs FROZEN 67.20 us same session, bound 56.66 us (not met)
e3_records.exact: 0 mismatches in the main, custom and staged runs

engine.applied: FROZEN reads T6; (a) is study 4's registered GPU term 66.6595 us (speed.a_gpu.no_go) and (c) study 4's handoff estimate 1.5432 us (speed.c_handoff.inherited). E3's same-session FROZEN median, 67.2015 us, is 0.54 us above (a): reported as a sensitivity (PLAN_R17.md section 8), never used in place of (a)

test_set.name: T6
test_set.sampler: stim Circuit.compile_detector_sampler(seed).sample(10,000, separate_observables=True) on the d = 17 verdict circuit; written by icmp.t4.write_npz (det = np.packbits of the detector bits, obs = observable 0, seed; stored members in name order, fixed timestamps)
test_set.host: x86-64 with AVX2 (an Alpine AMD EPYC node)
test_set.seedcheck: ising_compare/r17/seedcheck.sh: no integer of the 91 M namespace on any of 38 branches of the hub, the release and the paper repository (2026-10-10)

parts.source: data/study4/r3/t/work/r3_parts.json: the 8 timed batch-1 plans of S4-R3's session (M1 / M4 x fp16 / fp8 x builder level 3 / 5) and the official PyTorch numerics; each followed by plain PM and by correlated PM on the same residual

opponents.M1: Ising M1 + PM: every M1 part, plain PM on its residual (5 rows)
opponents.M1_corr: Ising M1 + correlated PM: every M1 part, correlated PM on its residual (5 rows)
opponents.minllr: min-LLR BP-OSD on T6 chunks 0-19 (row bposd_minllr)
opponents.bp60: BP 60 BP-OSD on T6 chunks 0-19 (row bposd_bp60)

accuracy.statistics: icmp.stats2.paired: exact two-sided McNemar; Newcombe (1998) method 8 at 97.5 %
accuracy.row: better iff diff_hi < 0 and mcnemar_p < 0.025 (ours at q = 8 % minus the row, on the same shots)
accuracy.cell: an opponent's accuracy cell holds iff every row of it is better

preservation.compare: ours at q = 8 % against ours at the registered tau (q = 10 %), both on all 1,000,000 T6 shots, from the same read
preservation.rule: preserved iff diff_hi < delta, where diff = LER(q 8 %) - LER(q 10 %) and diff_hi is the upper end of icmp.stats2.paired's 97.5 % Newcombe interval on the same shots
preservation.delta_source: half of the end nearest zero of study 4's registered 97.5 % interval of LER(ours) - LER(correlated PM) on T5, -1.6337557993120196e-4 (data/study4/r3/final/out/r3_summary.json, cells.pm_corr.accuracy.rows.pm_corr.hi): R17 may give up at most half of the accuracy advantage over its closest opponent that study 4 established with its own registered statistic (the 50 % retention rule of non-inferiority designs). Neither E17d nor K17d enters it

speed.b_cpu: the R17 CPU job (alpine/r17_cpu.sbatch): one exclusive Alpine amem node with an AMD EPYC 7713, core 8; three interleaved repetitions of the term on the q = 8 % mask and of the node's correlated PM per block on V17b chunk 0; b = max(term) x 714.05 / median(reference)
speed.opponents: inherited, as registered: plain PM and correlated PM the freeze's route.speed.grace_numerators_us; Ising M1 / M4 + PM phase_a.json's total_grace; + correlated PM phase_a.json's plan_us + pmshare_r3.json's share; BP-OSD phase_a.json's fastest_us
speed.cell: holds iff ours < the opponent, strictly
